text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-President Hrawi denies reports that he threatened to resign after government's decision to withdraw local elections bill.
-Russian President Yeltsin, during a meeting with Prime Minister Hariri in Moscow, expressed anxiety about tension in the Middle East.
-Lebanon and Russia signed economic and educational agreements.
-Lawyers stopped work for half an hour to protest against political interference in the judiciary.
-Hariri goes to Canada on Thursday after brief visit to Paris en route from Moscow.
-Mock Israeli air raids over south Lebanon.
-A Beirut court sentenced Lebanese businessman Ghassan Matraji and his gang to jail for smuggling drugs to Holland and Canada.
